covered.description: Every path from the group this reader was given whose patch and resulting file were read, spelled exactly as files.json spells it. A file read and found clean belongs here as much as one that produced six candidates.

candidates.description: Every place that looks wrong, unfiltered and unranked. Not findings: the judge confirms each one against the file before it becomes one.

path.description: A path from the group this reader was given, or null for a concern with no line of its own.

line.description: One of the numbers lines.json lists for path, or null when path is null.

concern.description: What looks wrong, in a sentence or two: what reaches this code and what goes wrong when it does.

rule.description: The file and section, or the ADR, this would rest on. Say so plainly where nothing in the repository states it.

notes.description: What the judge cannot see from the candidates: a file that could not be read and why, a concern spanning this group and one it was not given, or a ceiling that cut the group short. Empty when there is nothing.
